title: Valve P2P networking broken for more than 2 months
summary: A critical bug report indicating Valve's GameNetworkingSockets P2P networking has been broken for over 2 months, causing significant disruption to games and applications that depend on peer-to-peer connectivity. The issue appears to be a regression affecting the library's ability to establish direct connections between peers.
problem_solved: This is a bug report, not a solution - it documents a broken P2P networking feature in Valve's networking library that prevents direct peer connections.
why_valuable: Highlights a critical production issue affecting multiplayer game connectivity, providing visibility into a 2-month unresolved regression in widely-used open-source networking infrastructure.
